contract.sources: Normalized engine inputs. Strings in recommendations and owned arrays are opaque canonical IDs, not text for fuzzy matching.
contract.recommendations: Ordered array = ranked; [] = explicit not-applicable; null = unknown source. Every slot key is present.
contract.owned: Array = known actual available options; [] = known no matches; null = unreadable. Unknown owned data only matters for applicable slots.
contract.rankBounds: Inclusive min/max numeric rank among the same activity/category/tier population, or null when unranked. rankCases assume category is resolved.
contract.originLegalSets: Verified legal coexisting sets for this math case; null = unknown maximum. Synthetic sets are not evidence about real weapons.
contract.expected: Null numeric fields mean unrated/unknown. Booleans are exact. Compare other numbers at rawTolerance. Map bestPerfectOverall and omniPerfectOverall into the corresponding ScoreValue flags.
contract.provenance: Source-derived means source recommendations and rank data with constructed ownership. These are not live DIM socket fixtures.
contract.formatCases: Exact display assertions; inputs with value 100 and perfectOverall false deliberately test defensive false-perfection capping.
contract.orderingCases: Look up cases by ID and assert strict raw ordering independently for every named profile.
